releaseNotes: Fixed the ad blocker not working on YouTube: added a dedicated in-page ad skipper that detects and auto-skips video ads (YouTube serves ads through the same video infrastructure as regular content, so plain network-domain blocking alone cannot catch them)
Blocked additional YouTube/Google ad-tracking request patterns (ad pacing pings, pagead endpoints)
Hid companion/masthead/in-feed ad banners on YouTube via cosmetic filtering
